issues.issue: The dirt path from the west plateau into the west hollow, over Ramp_West (10-15.6, 7.5), breaks into disconnected flat stripes over the grass slope. It also leaves a flat dirt sheet overhanging the 1 m step lip (Gameplay lower-left, x 0-500, y 560-900; Overview x 560-760, y 600-720).
issues.fix: Keep the path polyline on the ramp centreline with a width no greater than the ramp's 3.6 m, and split it into separate path() calls on each side of every lip. Shared: path_ribbon should drape on ramp and slope faces rather than 'stay flat' when the surface is a sloped walkable.

issues.issue: The giant orange mushroom pair that closes the classic map's east end (Mushroom_Giant_Orange at (53.8, 5.8) scale 1.05 and (54.6, 10.8) scale 0.8) reads as about 3 m, the size of a bush (Overview x 790-920, y 745-800). It is not a landmark.
issues.fix: Scale them to about 2.0 and 1.6 and move them to the east edge (55.5, 4.5) and (55.8, 10.5) so they frame the end of the ground chain, with the log pile in front. Keep the front band low by placing them at the far side edge, not mid-band.

issues.issue: The front band (y 0-8.6, the full 76 m) is a bare flower meadow, about 20% of the Overview. The large paved square (31.5-47.5, 8.6-22.5) holds only the rainbow spring, two planters and a bench, so the town centre feels sparse.
issues.fix: Line the street front with low picket or hedge runs and put Pio's farm plot (Veg_Garden_Bed and the existing sacks) in front of the red tower. Mark the 6 classic Mystic Door points with small stones on the west street. Scale X1010000_RainbowSpring 1.35 -> 2.0 and move it nearer the square centre (38, 15).

issues.issue: TreeHouse_Giant (72.6, 19.0) shows the 'two orange-capped rooms grown into the trunk' only as tiny orange bits hidden under the canopy, and the Overview frame clips it.
issues.fix: Add a local X1010000_TreePods asset: two orange spotted cap pods with round windows on the trunk's -y/-x side at about 2.5 m and 5 m. Optionally move the tree to x 71.5 so it sits inside the frame.

issues.issue: The Tree_Birch_Orange canopy at (22.7, 22.0) clips into the T11 ledge cliff and overlaps the red tower's cap (Overview x 450-520, y 450-530).
issues.fix: Move it to about (21.4, 18.6) or scale it to 0.8. Keep it clear of the rope/ladder sightline at x 26-29.

issues.issue: The full-width slopes (Slope_Bank_Furrow, Slope_Furrow_Hump, Slope_Hump_Furrow, Slope_Furrow_EastBank, all 32.2 m wide) end at the front edge with exposed triangular dark wedges where the slope meets the lower bed level and the plinth cliff (Overview x 640-870, y 735-800 and x 960-1080, y 800-830).
issues.fix: Start the ramps at y of about 0.6 and add a front terrace strip along y 0-1 at bed level, or give the ramp sides grass-capped closing faces. Alternatively let the beds' terrace bodies extend under the slopes so no void shows.

issues.issue: The kit Haystack reads as a smooth yellow blob or cheese wheel (TF Gameplay x 780-1010, y 690-770), with no straw texture or silhouette.
issues.fix: Add a tapered straw silhouette with banding rings, a ragged top tuft and a few loose straw sticks, or apply a straw material with streaks.

issues.issue: Interior Overview renders frame the room at about 35% of the image, with lots of empty sky. The Weapon Store Overview also shows a neighbouring interior's corner at the top-right (INTERIOR_STAGE spacing is 40 m).
issues.fix: Fit the orthographic scale to the room's bounding box plus about 15% margin for kind='interior'. Increase INTERIOR_STAGE spacing to 80 m or more, or hide the other stage rooms when rendering an interior.

issues.issue: VALIDATION flags intentional collision proxies (Chest_Lid, Crate_High/Low, Pipe_Hump, Tank_Lid, all hide_render with _Vis twins) as hidden objects. It flags wall-mounted props (X1010001_Eave_4m, WeaponSign, CrossedSwords, PipeRun, X1010003_Poster) as floating. This noise hides real issues.
issues.fix: Tag the proxies with obj['collision_proxy']=True and wall props with obj['wall_mounted']=True (or set it at asset level), and exempt both in the hidden and floating checks.

verdicts.strengths: Strongest identity in the region. Three staircases of rainbow giant-mushroom caps (east, west, mid/top) give the garden its name, since the v8 data has no mushroom props. The terraces read as an amphitheatre stepping back and up (P01 rock pillar, P03, P07, P10, P14/P13). Brief dressing is present: berry hedges, clover, marigold crown on P02, irises on P13, white birches. The debug route reads cleanly: door, zig-zag stone stairs, lawn, ladder, rope, caps. All 7 routes pass, and it is clearly distinct from Snail Garden next door. The main faults are the trail arrival and the door/hill split.

Visually one of the more developed fields. It reads as a kitchen garden: a fenced sunken vegetable basin with scarecrow, tomato plants and veg beds; carrot rows, strawberries and a sunflower summit on the top beds; trellises behind the long ropes; hedges closing both ends; a clear courtyard path down from the door. It is distinct from Mushroom Garden. The verdict is needs_work mainly because the project's own validator fails it (route ArchToCentral, which is a one-line fix), plus the door/trail corridor problem. It is not a judgment on the art.

Every classic beat is present and traversable (14 routes pass): the door block on the central mound with ladder and rope into the zig-zag tower, the west stack and rope to T22, the east branch with log piles, the upper ring with ladders to the summit, and the stair of stones stepping down the back. The rainbow fountain in the east hollow is a charming, readable landmark. The trail arrives cleanly in front of the door at the front edge.

Arrival is clean: the causeway lands straight on the 7 m hub at the door block, with the barrel door beside the portal. The island ring, linked by land-bridge tongues, gives a readable climb, every climbable is checked at build time, and all 13 routes pass. Autumn birches poke up between the islands, daffodils sit on T0/T3, and the rope ladder is present. Its silhouette is clearly different from Mid Forest I.

issues.issue: traversal.clear_routes() silently deletes authored m.place props in the Trees/Foliage/Rocks categories when they stand within 0.9 m of a route (build_report 'cleared_from_routes'). Casualties in this region: 1000006 loses X1000006_Umbrella_Leaf, a landmark named in the brief, plus 11 bushes (4 Olive_Bush, Bush_B x2, Bush_C x4), which is a large part of why the island ring looks bare. 1000004 loses Veg_Garden_Bed, X1000004_Carrot_Row and X1000004_Strawberry_Bush from the T1 'literal garden bed'. 1000003 loses a green and a teal lawn birch, a Berry_Hedge, Mushroom_Giant_Blue and Bush_B. 1000005 loses 7 bushes, including one strawberry bush. Authors never see these deletions in their renders.
issues.fix: Only auto-clear instances spawned by m.scatter (tag them at scatter time). Never clear assets tagged 'landmark'. Report authored m.place hits as 'blocked' and fail MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK (or at least print a loud warning in build_map.py) so the author moves the prop.

issues.issue: The giant umbrella-leaf island (T4) has no umbrella leaf in the build. X1000006_Umbrella_Leaf at (17.8, 25.4), scale 1.3, is removed because the UpperRing route snakes across T4 through (16.0,26.0) -> (15.4,28.0) -> (17.0,27.6) -> (19.0,26.6) -> (20.0,25.6), within about 1 m of its leaves. Olive_Bush at (19.6, 28.0) and several island bushes go the same way.
issues.fix: Make UpperRing hug T4's front edge: (14.6,24.0) -> (17.5,24.2) -> (20.0,24.6) -> Tongue_T4_T2. Give the rope ladder a separate short route, (15.0,25.0) -> (15.4,28.0). Re-place the umbrella leaf as the island centrepiece at about (18.6, 27.6), scale about 1.6, at least 2.3 m from every route point. Move the cleared bushes off the route lines.

issues.issue: The Field trail ends in the back of the door dome. Barrel_Door_Mound sits at (6.0, 31.05), directly on the trail axis and inside the 4.5 m corridor that AUTHORING requires to be clear from the anchor (6,29) out to the footprint edge (y=30). The Overview shows the dirt trail running into the dome's back and reappearing in front of it, with the portal swirl facing away from the arriving player and no visible way around. The classic identity is also split: the barrel door belongs in the face of the P02 hill with the short ladder beside it, but here the door is a separate small dome at x=6 and Ladder_DoorHill is on P02's face 7.5 m away at (13.5, 22.9).
issues.fix: Option A: extend DoorHill_P02 west (to about x 8.5 at y 26-31), set the barrel door into that hill's west/front face beside the swirl, leave (6, 27.8-31) open ground for the trail, and move Ladder_DoorHill next to the door (x about 9.5). Option B: define a local X1000003_Tunnel_Mound with an open arch on its back, so the trail visibly enters the hill and leaves through the barrel door. Either way the 4.2 m trail strip must reach the swirl without passing through geometry.

issues.issue: The validator fails this map. Route ArchToCentral has a 0.46 m step at (26.4, 21.5), on Steps_T9_T7 ((25.8,21.5) -> (27.8,21.5), rise 0.75 m over 2 m). The walk-step limit is 0.45 m, and AUTHORING says a map is not done until MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK is True.
issues.fix: Replace the stone stairs with a ramp that mirrors the working Ramp_T10_T7, e.g. m.ramp('Ramp_T9_T7', (25.0,21.5,T9+0.02), (27.6,21.5,T7+0.03), 2.4, extend=0.3). Alternatively start the stairs at x 25.0 so the run is 2.6 m or more and every riser is 0.4 m or less.

issues.issue: Barrel_Door_Mound at (14.0, 31.05) sits in the corridor in front of anchor (14,29), and the trail's final segment points into the dome's back. The back lane at shelf height (BackLane route) was designed as the bypass, but it cannot be seen: the last 8-10 m of the 47.5 m trail run behind CarrotBed_T1 (y 24-28.2, top 11.25, a 9 m column) and behind Mushroom Garden's P13/P14 backs. From the iso camera the player vanishes and reappears beside the door. The classic 'door in the earth block, ladder up to the strawberry roof' is also split: DoorBlock_T13 with its ladder sits 15 m away at the front-left, (-0.8..8.6, 9.6..17.4).
issues.fix: Move the mound out of the corridor, e.g. to x 17.5-18 against the T9/summit cliff with the door facing -x toward the swirl, or use a through-tunnel mound with an open back. Pull CarrotBed_T1's back edge to y 26 or less (or lower it) so the back-left corner (x 0-12, y 26-31) and the trail mouth stay visible. Paint a path along BackLane, (0,30.2) -> (14,28.6). If possible, give the door a block read: dress the dome top with the strawberry patch and add a short ladder on its side.

issues.issue: The map reads as one generic flat green mesa, much like the 1000001/1000002 terrace stacks in Region_WestAmherstForests. Branch_T19 (x 14.2-27.9, y 13.4-26.6), Branch_T16 (x 27.2-38.8, y 13.4-28.6), Canopy_T8 (about 250 m2), T6 and T5 are huge, nearly empty slabs: Overview centre, 630-1170 x 380-610. The 'middle of the forest' giant tree is not used as the composition's spine. Tree_Giant_A is pushed to the back rim at (17.2, 40.6), scale 0.9, half out of frame, and blends into the world forest filler.
issues.fix: Build a local giant trunk (about 5-6 m diameter, rising above T0 with its own canopy) at about (19, 22), between the tower and the T19/T8 slabs. Cut T19, T16 and T8 into branch-shaped shelves 4-6 m deep that radiate from it, linked by root/branch bridges, and let the ground show between them. Add undergrowth clusters (ferns, bushes, small blue/yellow mushrooms, logs) and 6-10 more trees on the remaining slabs.

issues.issue: The signature jump tower reads as a gentle staircase of overlapping green discs marching back: 12 stones of radius 1.35 between x 8.4 and 11.0, rising 4.6 m over 14 m of depth (about 18 deg). Gameplay 470-790 x 0-690 shows no air between the stones and no tower silhouette. The framework has no jump mechanic and caps walk steps at 0.45 m, so the classic vertical column cannot simply be raised.
issues.fix: Wind the 11 hops (0.42 m each) in a spiral around a central rock pillar or trunk (radius 2.5-3 m, 30-35 deg per stone), as the brief proposes. The stair then gains its 4.6 m in a compact footprint and reads as a tower. Cut the cap overlap down to small tongues so slivers of air show, and give the stones shelf-fungus or mossy caps.

issues.issue: The sky islands read as flat green tables on uniform striped dirt posts. The dell below uses the same bright grass green as the island tops, so the 'floating island high above an autumn valley' depth barely reads (Overview 350-1070 x 200-650): the hub looks only slightly raised. The V-shaped valley and the fenced high east meadow are not legible, and the autumn colour is limited to scattered trees.
issues.fix: Give the dell an autumn ground (golden/olive grass top material, or a dense orange/yellow leaf-litter scatter on T23a-g) and keep the island caps fresh green, so the gaps glow and separate the layers. Taper the stalks more (stalk 0.2-0.25 with an extra root-ball tier) and hang roots/vines under the caps. Make the east-plateau stake fence and yellow twin tree read as a feature, e.g. a double fence line with a gate, and a bigger tree.

issues.issue: The low arch of eight stepping stones reads as one solid wooden wall (a stack of drums) against the T9/T10 cliff: gameplay 600-1280 x 360-590. The stumps are big (radius 1.2-1.45, 2.65-3.85 m tall), overlap by 0.45 m, differ by only 0.4 m in height, and bow forward only 1.85 m (y 14.6-16.45). The classic 'arch of small stones curving over the basin' is lost.
issues.fix: Shrink the stump radius to about 0.9-1.0 and cut ARCH_OVERLAP to about 0.15, using short plank or root tongues for walk links so air shows between posts. Bow the middle stumps 2.5-3 m forward over the basin. Give each stump its own read: moss cap, root flare, a tiny mushroom, varied bark tint.

issues.issue: The switchback turf ramps into the basin (Ramp_T22_T21 (16.0,9.4)->(13.4,9.4), Ramp_T23_T22, Ramp_Basin_T23, plus Landing_T22/T23) read as flat cardboard planks. Dark triangular slits show where the ramp ends meet the tiers, and the top of Ramp_T22_T21 creases where it cuts into the T21 cap (gameplay 330-660 x 480-760). The brief's 'stepped drop into the basin' turns into a fiddly zig-zag.
issues.fix: Replace each 0.75 m riser with a short stone or turf stair flight (m.stairs with M_StoneWall/M_Rock, about 2.8 m wide) along one straight line from the shelf to the basin, or with one wide straight ramp per riser buried 0.5 m inside the upper cap and flush at the foot. Drop the separate dirt landing pads.

issues.issue: The main (east) mushroom stair tucks behind Central_P07's back lip. Caps at (21.2,27.4), (23.4,27.8), (24.2,25.7) and (22.4,24.2) sit just behind P07's back edge (y 23-23.9, top 6.8 m), so the last yellow and orange caps are half hidden. The classic main stair reads as a jumbled pile of discs (gameplay 840-1170 x 150-280).
issues.fix: Shift the chain 1.5-2 m back/east (y +1.5), or notch P07's back edge to y of about 22 at x 20-25, so all five caps show their full tops. Keep about 0.5 m overlap but alternate depth more.

issues.issue: portal_issues is empty for both 1000003 and 1000004, even though a non-clearable architecture prop (Barrel_Door_Mound) sits in the required 4.5 m corridor in front of each edge portal, and on the trail's final _In segment. The kit also has no door asset for maps whose trail arrives from behind the door. The Field-side door mounds work (the trail leaves from their front); the garden-side ones do not.
issues.fix: Add a validator check that raycasts the 4.5 m corridor (anchor to footprint edge) and the trail _In/_Out ramps for non-clearable geometry, reported as a portal issue. Add a kit variant of Barrel_Door_Mound with an open back arch (a 'through door') for back-edge anchors.

issues.issue: Neighbouring Dangerous Forest / scenery trees (pines and a large round tree) fill the front-right of 1000006's gameplay shot (about 830-1600 x 520-900). They hide T19/T20, the dell rope at (30.4, 2.75) and part of the hub's east side, so the map's own view is cluttered by another map's dressing.
issues.fix: In world/layout, keep a low-scenery buffer (no tall trees) in the strip directly in front (camera side) of each map footprint, or cap tree height in 1000002's back row. Alternatively push 1000006 back or offset it so the maps do not stack along the camera axis.

issues.issue: The trails to the two Mid Forest maps are very long, straight brown stripes: in04 to 1000005 is 58 m with -0.5 m rise (layout gap is 12 m), and in05 to 1000006 is 64 m with 9.2 m rise. Both cut across empty terraced world slopes (Region_WestAmherstForests) and dominate the region read. Both arrive straight and correctly at the maps' front-edge portals.
issues.fix: Tighten the auto-gap for these links, or let trails take one or two waypoints so they curve along contours or switchback. Dress long runs with tree clumps, lamps or a rest bench, and break one with a small bridge. Rails alone (every 4 m) are not enough.

issues.issue: At overview scale the Lily_Of_The_Valley clumps (scale 1.5) read as white birds or bats with spread wings: the bells are flat white domes splayed sideways on three arching stems (Overview 380-420 x 380-400 and 630-720 x 590-630). The daffodils read as cattail or reed sticks.
issues.fix: Make the lilies one tall arched stem with a dense vertical row of 6-8 small white bells, plus two big upright leaf blades; avoid the sideways splay. Give the daffodils larger trumpet heads tilted toward the camera (-y).

issues.issue: The Shroom mob proxies (small red caps) match the size and shape of the decor Mushroom_Yellow_S/Blue_S scattered on the spawn tiers: in the gameplay shot the red mob at about (1020,430) sits beside a yellow decor cap at (935,505) and a blue one at (1095,470). Mushroom_Giant_Red/Orange decor also share the mob colours. In a map defined by a 'swarm of Shrooms', the enemies are hard to pick out.
issues.fix: Remove the small decor mushrooms from the spawn tiers (lawn, P07, P10, P14), or swap them for clover/flowers. Keep the giant mushrooms only on edges and the back bed, away from spawn areas.

issues.issue: A thin dark seam runs across the arrival causeway at the hub lip (gameplay at about y 620), where the trail's _In ramp meets the middle ramp. The _In strip also lies on the hub cap at the same z (7.0), which risks z-fighting at other camera angles.
issues.fix: In world.trails(), overlap and weld the _In/_Out ramps with the middle run (extend 0.6 m into each other), and lift the in-map part of the _In segment about 2 cm above the cap, as paths already do.

issues.issue: Identical local assets are duplicated across 1000003, 1000004 and 1000005 (Clover_Patch, Marigold_Patch, Iris_Patch, Butterfly, Strawberry_Bush, Birch variants), and so are helpers (cap_edge, edge_pair, hemp_rope). Ropes come in two styles: the hemp_rope used in 1000003/1000004 has a flat peg-beam top that reads like a signpost, while 1000005/1000006 use the kit rope.
issues.fix: Promote one Clover/Marigold/Iris/Strawberry/Butterfly asset and one rope style (with the anchor beam option) to the kit, and switch these four maps to them. That gives the adjacent maps consistent props and cuts duplicate meshes.

issues.issue: VALIDATION lists floating props here that appear intentional: 11 Rock_Cliff_Stone in 1000005 embedded in cliff faces (gaps 1-4.6 m), and clover/marigold/strawberry placed on the door-dome roofs in 1000003/1000004 (gap about 1.8 m). These false positives bury real floating props among the 245 flagged.
issues.fix: Let the floating check accept support from any mesh surface (dome roofs, cliff faces), or let authors mark an instance as 'embedded'. Then re-review whatever genuinely remains.

verdicts.strengths: Data plus region view only; I did not inspect this map's own render. All 4 routes pass with no blocked props. The bluff ladder and the house-door sub-routes are declared. The trail to 10000 is a flat 12 m link.

Traversal passes and portals line up with the anchors (region view only). It is the reference town, but the module is 87 lines and the region render shows only 2-3 houses on a flat field, so it is thinner than most hunting fields.
Region view plus data. All 6 routes pass. The door link to 20001 is reciprocal. Only 1 bush was auto-cleared.

Rendered. The best interior: a curved mushroom-cap cutaway with a loft and ladder, distinct from the 3 box-shell shops. Traversal passes and it has no hidden collision proxies. Its 'floating' flags (BellLamp, RoundWindow) are wall-mounted false positives.
Region view plus data. 8 routes pass. The summit portal feeds the 27 degree trail down to 40000.
Module and data read. Clean amphitheatre layout and the reference hunting map. Every route passes, but the Main route accepts a 0.47 m one-way drop at the entry-ramp lip (see issues).
Rendered. Readable stepped-stone climbs, visible tiers and a good relationship to the lake shore. Traversal passes (7 authored trees and bushes were auto-cleared).
Rendered. Rich tier structure with 15 routes and 18 spawns. Traversal fails only because 2 intentionally short vines have no ground at their foot.
Rendered. Clear fork with both exits readable and traversal passing. There are minor terrace-seam and path-tear artifacts near the centre stairs.

Rendered. A strong landmark set: lighthouse, ship in a harbour basin, domed houses and stalls. 13 routes and 7 NPCs. Traversal passes. The large empty cobble areas are a composition issue, not a technical one.
Rendered. Traversal passes and the dressing is nautical, but the shell is cloned from 1010001 and it has 7 hidden collision crates.
Rendered (gameplay view). The hub with 8 portals works and traversal passes. It is the heaviest map (453k triangles) and shows path tearing and terrace seams on the front band.
Rendered. A good concept: the spiral shelf climb round a giant tree plus ridge ropes. But the route-clearing pass deleted the trunk landmark, and one rope fails its foot check.

Rendered. Good cliff faces with embedded stones and vines. Traversal passes only after 28 hand-placed props were silently deleted from route corridors. Visible terrace seams and path tears along the main path.
Rendered. Distinctive mushroom-cap stepping stairs and a hillock door portal, and traversal passes. One landmark-tagged Mushroom_Giant_Blue was auto-deleted.
Rendered. A distinctive stump wall and garden beds. Traversal fails by 1 cm (a 0.46 m step) on ArchToCentral.
Data plus region view only; I did not inspect this map's own render. 14 routes pass. Its link trail was auto-lengthened to 58 m.
Data plus region view only; I did not inspect this map's own render. 13 routes pass, with 12 authored bushes auto-cleared. 302k triangles.
Rendered. A well-structured hill town: plaza, plateau with paired rope and ladder, belvedere, rainbow spring and gate. ToTownstreet is blocked by the house sitting on the in01 trail corridor.
Rendered. Detailed forge interior with a deck, a walkable beam and a rope. Traversal passes. It has 2 hidden collision proxies and hosts helper code that 3 other maps import.
Rendered. A strong cutaway two-storey house with a loft ladder. The main through-route is blocked at the west doorstep. The trail to 1010004 reads as a flat slab in this view.
Rendered. Readable shop with a spiral stair and beam drop, and traversal passes. It has 3 hidden collision proxies and reuses the 1010001 shell and eaves.
Data plus region view only; I did not inspect this map's own render. 14 routes pass and it is visibly flower-dense at region scale.
Data plus region view only; I did not inspect this map's own render. 13 routes pass, with 7 authored bushes auto-cleared.
Rendered. A distinctive tomato-trellis boardwalk and crop beds. The WestBed route is blocked by a scarecrow and a crate.

issues.issue: traversal.clear_routes deletes hand-placed content, not only scatter. It removes any collection instance whose asset category is Trees, Foliage or Rocks found within 0.9 m of a route, without checking whether it came from scatter() or m.place(). Its docstring and ITERATION_LOG I6 call the 96 removed items 'scattered clutter', but almost all were placed by hand. Evidence: Dangerous Forest (1000002) lost 28 objects, but its scatter() calls only use Grass_Tuft and Flower_Patch, so all 28 were hand-placed. They include Tree_Pine_A x5, Log_A, Rock_Boulder x3, and 3 Stump_A, one of them the 'launch point under the jump-grab vine' at (19.8, 13.9). In a Small Forest (1000001) lost X1000001_GiantTrunk_White, the map's central landmark: the render shows the spiral shelves orbiting empty air. Mushroom Garden (1000003) lost a landmark-tagged Mushroom_Giant_Blue. The renders were made after the deletion, so the losses are baked into iter1.
issues.fix: In MapCtx.scatter tag the instances it creates (e['scattered'] = True) and have clear_routes delete only tagged objects. Report authored trees, rocks and logs as 'blocked' like other props. Never delete anything tagged 'landmark'. Print every deletion in build_map output. Rebuild and re-render 1000001, 1000002 and 1000003, then re-place the authored props or reroute.

issues.issue: The giant white trunk at TREE_C (12, 21), the landmark of In a Small Forest, was removed by route clearing. The Floor_to_Crown spiral route samples pass within 0.9 m of the trunk, so the trunk's own geometry counts as 'on the route'. The P25 crown disc and the spiral shelves now float with nothing under them.
issues.fix: After the shared clear_routes fix, also move the spiral route points (the _polar(...) samples in Floor_to_Crown, To_P06, To_P11 and To_P19) out to shelf mid-width, at least 1.0 m from the trunk surface, so the trunk does not report as 'blocked'. Re-render to confirm the trunk reads under the crown.

issues.issue: House_Mushroom_OrangeSpotted is placed at (64.0, 41.3), across the back edge, right on the in01 anchor (64, 39). issues.issue: The trails between maps are the most visibly broken geometry on the island, and nothing validates them. (1) Trail_Rail fences are placed 2.35 m from the centreline, but the ramp is 4.2 m wide (half-width 2.1 m), so every rail stands 0.25 m outside the embankment top. On the 12.7 m drop from 40002 to 50000 that is up to about 0.6 m off: rails hover in the air beside the side wall near the low end and sink near the high end (crop of the 40002 overview). issues.fix: In world.trails: build each trail as one swept ribbon along a Chaikin-smoothed polyline (p0, p1, p2, p3) so the junctions have no seams. Raycast each rail onto the trail surface (world.ground) at offset half_width - 0.3, or build a continuous rope rail from the ramp's own profile. Give embankments sloped grass sides or a bevel instead of vertical dirt walls. For rises above about 8 m, use a switchback or stairs plus a landing. Add a 'trail' pass to traversal.check_map that walks portal-to-portal over world.ground, and add the WORLD collections to the floating check.

issues.issue: The route validator mishandles climbs, so at least 11 map modules carry local workarounds that make climb validation nearly empty. climb_route is in 40001, 40002, 50000 and 60000; _climb_split in 1010000 and 1010002; edge_pair in 1000003, 1000004 and 1010004; _check_climb in 1000002 and 1000006; and 1010001 has a hand-made two-sample 'Rope' route. Their comments say 'a climb only validates as the first pair of a route'. The reason: rounded cap lips produce two sub-0.45 m samples that the 1.2 m slope window then flags as 'steep'. The helpers emit 0.38 m two-point routes that straddle the cliff, so each ladder only proves the ground on either side. Separately, routes are walked in one direction only, so allowed one-way drops (up to 2.6 m) on two-way paths go unnoticed; see 40000.
issues.fix: In check_route: when a 'steep' window or a step over 0.45 m lies within CLIMB_RADIUS of a climbable whose z-span covers it, classify it as a climb. Snap a sample to the cliff edge found by face_point. Walk every route in both directions unless m.route(..., one_way=True) is set. Then delete the local climb helpers and restore natural approach-climb-continue routes.

issues.issue: Rope_Hill_P08 at (25.4, 10.9) has z0=0.8 hard-coded and fails the foot check (no ground within 0.6 m of 0.8 m within a 1.3 m radius). Stairs St_Hill_P08 start at z=1.2 at y=4.6, so the hill under the rope is probably not at 0.8.

issues.issue: docs/VALIDATION.md and validation_report.json are stale and do not match the validator. validate.py was modified at 06:23:07, after the report was written at 06:22:46. The code now has TRI_BUDGET_PER_MAP = 600_000 while the report says 'maps over 400000', and a WALL_MOUNTED name whitelist (cliff_stone, vine, eave, sign, ship...) that would exempt 200+ of the 245 reported 'floating' items. issues.fix: Re-run validate.py against the current .blend and commit the fresh report. Replace the WALL_MOUNTED name list with a geometric test: an instance passes if its bounding box is within 0.15 m of any terrain or architecture surface in any direction (BVH find_nearest), or if it carries an explicit wall_mounted tag set by the placing helper. Restore a budget that means something (see the poly-count issue).

issues.issue: validate.py has reporting gaps. It marks a map as failing when traversal.ok is False, but only writes issue lines for routes and portals, so climbable_issues and out_of_bounds_terrain fail silently (40002 and 1000001 are listed with no reason). The docstring promises portal 'grounding', but no grounding check exists in the file. issues.issue: Dangerous Forest passed traversal only because 28 authored props were deleted (see the shared clear_routes issue), so its routes run through the author's own dressing. The gameplay render also shows visible terrace seams: neighbouring caps at slightly different heights leave dark lips across the main path near x 330-360 and 1060-1100 (screen), and the dirt path tears into offset rectangles there.

issues.issue: geo.path_ribbon tears where it crosses terrace seams and lips. It drapes vertices every 0.6 m, so a row on the lower cap and the next row on the higher, overhanging cap form a steep facet that hides under the grass lip. Combined with the 'stay flat over lips of 0.3 m or more' rule, this leaves hard rectangular notches and floating flat tabs. Visible in the 1000000 gameplay view (bottom band and left stepping stones), 1000002 gameplay and 50000 (near the centre stairs).
issues.fix: In path_ribbon: split the ribbon into separate rounded-end segments wherever consecutive rows differ by more than 0.08 m (no facet across a seam), and lift each segment 0.03 m above the higher surface it rests on. Add a build warning when a path crosses a lip of more than 0.15 m without a ramp or stairs, so authors fix the terrain.

issues.issue: LY.resolve() lengthens link gaps in silent 2 m steps until footprints stop overlapping, and gives up at gap + 60 m without any warning even if the overlap remains. The 1000000:in04 to 1000005 link was authored at 12 m and came out at 58 m. With the authored 64 m link to 1000006, these become two long straight causeways through the West Amherst forest region, running past the plinths of 1000001 and 1000002 (Region_WestAmherstForests).
issues.fix: Log every auto-lengthened gap and treat a gap over 2.5x its authored value, or any leftover overlap, as a build error. Fix 1000005 and 1000006 by adjusting bearings or anchors (for example move 1000005 west of 1000001, or rotate its bearing) so the links stay under about 25 m. Shorter links also make the trail fixes above easier.

issues.issue: The Southperry Armor Store reuses the Weapon Store shell (cut_room, banded_beam, crate_block imported from m1010001) and its layout. The debug overviews of 60001 and 1010001 are nearly the same: door on the left wall, counter at the back-left, the same rafter and beam roof, crates and a stair at the front-right up to a back-right deck, and an almost identical route shape. Only the paint and props differ.

issues.issue: The interior stage puts rooms only 40 m apart (2400, 2440, 2480, 2520). The overview camera frames the footprint plus zmax + 10 m, so each interior fills about 40% of the frame and the neighbouring room's corner shows at top-right (60001 and 1010001 overviews).

issues.issue: build.map_labels puts 6 m extruded '<name> <id>' text at z+26 in DEBUG, and the per-map debug overviews render it right over the map (Amherst, 1010002, 40002, 60000 and 1020001 debug overviews), hiding the routes and portals the debug pass is meant to show.

issues.issue: The 'blocked' test casts a single vertical ray on the route centreline, so a prop 0.3-0.7 m to either side of a 1.5 m-wide character is never caught, and the 2.5 m minimum path width is never checked. _passable() exempts by name anything containing sign, banner, lantern, flag or portal, so solid posts like X1010000_BannerPole or Sign_Board can stand in a corridor unreported.
issues.fix: Cast 3 rays across the corridor (offsets 0 and plus or minus 0.6 m), like clear_routes already does. Replace the name-based exemption with a passable tag set in the asset registry for genuinely thin or overhead items.

issues.issue: The island is 11.67M evaluated triangles across 24,239 objects. Map 1000000 has 453k, and nine maps are over 290k. The inverted-hull solidify outline doubles the triangles of every outlined mesh, and the budget was raised from 400k to 600k instead of being met.
issues.fix: Turn outlines off for small Props and Foliage (footprint under 1 m) and for terrain caps hidden by fringe. Lower the subdiv on Flower_Patch and Grass_Tuft. Keep the per-map budget at 400k and report the top 10 assets by instanced triangle count in validate.py, so the next pass targets the real heavy hitters.

verdicts.strengths: The hub reads as a busy, layered hillside, and all 8 exits are present (6 side doors plus west00/east00). The front dirt road keeps the classic undulation: plateau, swale, rope yard, steps down into the Hollow, cliff, steps down to the East Gate. The Gameplay shot is well framed and shows the most recognizable props from the data: the barrels (3 upright, 1 on its side) on P11b, the red toadstool cluster on P11a, the V-fork of round stepping discs rising off the plateau's back, the Mushroom Garden barrel-door mound and the vine-wrapped signpost on G7. The back-edge barrel-arch gates are a charming way to frame the trails, and the trails pass straight through them. The East Gate sunflowers, the P12 balcony with its ropes and the West Lookout zig-zag of stump pillars are all built. All 12 routes pass traversal. The mob species, and keeping the Orange Mushrooms on the summit and by the in01 door, match the v8 data.

The 3D concept is strong and mostly executed. A single 300-degree spiral of 14 grassy shelves (one 0.4 m step each) replaces the zig-zag floater tower, and the junction shelves merge into the P06/P11/P19 west branch ledges. P24 is a high back-east ridge with the three classic ropes hanging off its face. The 4-step P02 hill with its ladder sits in the front-right, and the P08/P10/P12 stumps step up to the P14 ledge. The Gameplay framing is focused, and the autumn yellow/orange birches and red-berry bushes match the brief. Mobs follow the data: Orange Mushrooms and Shrooms on the floor, snails on the ledges. Every route except the one rope passes.

It is the most distinctive of the three. The four leafy green vines hanging from the Great Shelf lip read immediately as the classic vine climb and make a strong Gameplay hero shot. The three-band sandwich reads clearly in 3D: a forest floor rising east in two steps (0/0.9/1.8 m), the Great Shelf stepping down eastward (7.6/6.8/6.0) so the ravine narrows from west to east, and a battlement ridge with pillars and crenel steps along the back rim. The 8 Orange Mushroom proxies on the floor trail read well and match the map's 'strong mobs' identity. The ramps are grass-topped and there are no plank structures, which respects 'nothing man-made'. The build-time vine self-checks (_check_climb) are good practice, and all 11 routes pass.

issues.issue: You cannot walk to the in00 door (In a Small Forest). The anchor (4,47) sits inside P27_Knoll: rounded_rect(3.6,46.2,8.8,49.8) has top 8.2, so the portal and the world trail's inner slab are built at local z 8.2. The approach terrace P20 is at 6.4. Raycast probes on MapleIsland.blend show P20 at 6.4 up to y 45.3 and the trail slab at 8.22 from y 45.6. That is a 1.8 m vertical wall inside the gate, and it is visible in the Overview as a soil face under the left back gate (about 180-210, 280-300). Traversal passed only because VFork_West_to_in00 stops at (1.2,43.6), 3.5 m short of the portal and 1.8 m lower.
issues.fix: Move P27_Knoll clear of the gate opening, for example rounded_rect(6.8,46.2,9.8,49.8) (west edge at least about 6.6 so the 5 m arch opening stays on P20). Move the knoll tree at (4.6,48.8) onto it at about (8.4,48.6). The portal and trail then start at 6.4, which also halves the drop to In a Small Forest from -3.6 m to about -1.8 m. Extend VFork_West_to_in00 to end at (4.0,46.6) so the validator walks right into the gate.

issues.issue: The giant white trunk, the map's signature landmark, is missing from the build. docs/build_report.json lists X1000001_GiantTrunk_White under cleared_from_routes, and inspecting MapleIsland.blend shows no trunk object at all. The 14 spiral shelves, the crown disc P25 and 17 X1000001_BracketFungus brackets therefore float around an empty core. This is the dominant element of the Gameplay shot (top-left: a pinwheel of slabs over bare lawn) and of the Overview (about 520-760, 380-600). The probe that hit is likely the 140-degree limb stub (base z 6.55). It hangs only about 1.4-1.7 m over Shelf_07 (139 degrees, z 4.8), inside clear_routes' 0.25 + 1.4 m head-clearance ray. Because the trunk is a 'Trees' asset, the whole trunk was deleted.
issues.fix: Register the trunk asset outside CLEARABLE_CATEGORIES (for example category 'Landmarks' or 'Architecture'), so a collision is reported as 'blocked' instead of silently deleted. Move the 140-degree limb into the spiral gap (305-355 degrees) or raise it to base z of at least 7.0. Change Floor_to_Crown's last point from _polar(300.0, 1.2), which is inside the trunk footprint, to a point reached straight inward from shelf 13, for example _polar(1.0, 1.0). Rebuild and confirm that the trunk is present and that the shelves and fungi are attached to it.

issues.issue: traversal.clear_routes silently deletes any instance in Trees/Foliage/Rocks whose geometry is within 1.65 m above a route sample. It ignores the 'landmark' tag and authored intent, and it deletes the whole collection instance even when only a limb or root is hit. In this region it removed: the giant trunk of 1000001, 28 authored props in 1000002 (including all 4 berry bushes and the jump-grab stump), 4 bushes in 1000000, and a tree and 5 bushes in 1000001. The only trace is a list in build_report.json.
issues.fix: In clear_routes, skip assets tagged 'landmark' or with a footprint of 3 m or more, and report them as blocked (with route name and sample xy) so the author must fix the route. Print every removal with its xy in the build log. Ideally only auto-remove items placed by m.scatter, since the docstring says scatter is the target; authored m.place props should be reported instead of removed.

issues.issue: The traversal check never verifies that a declared route actually reaches each anchor portal. portal_issues only checks that a portal stands on ground. That is how the 1.8 m wall in front of 1000000:in00 passed with traversal ok=true and MAP_TRAVERSAL_OK. The same blind spot can hide unreachable exits on any map.
issues.fix: For every edge or door portal, require at least one route point within about 1.5 m of the portal xy and within ±0.45 m of its z, and require the route's last segment to walk onto the portal's ground. Otherwise emit a high-severity portal_unreachable issue. Optionally run a flood-fill on walkable ground from each route's start to every portal.

issues.category: identity props deleted by own routes

issues.issue: The classic Dangerous Forest is entered on the top-left battlement (P03) and is a descent, with long vines as the only way back up. issues.issue: The classic arrival is mid-air on P14, looking down onto the glade. Here the out00 portal is at the front-right corner on the 1.6 m hilltop P02d, because the trail arrives at (34,1). The player then walks west and climbs the P08-P12 stumps to reach P14, which is where m.player stands. The arrival marker and the real arrival disagree, and the 'look down into the forest' moment is lost. The trail also falls 3.6 m from the Field gate.
issues.fix: Add a narrow arrival pillar at the anchor, for example rounded_rect(31.8,-0.6,36.4,3.6) with top 4.4, and a short plank bridge (m.bridge) or grassy causeway from (34,3.4,4.4) to P14 at (34,10.9,4.4). Shift the P02d twin birches west of x 31. Once the Field in00 fix lands (portal at world 11.4), the trail becomes a gentle +1.0 m rise (SF at 8 + 4.4 = 12.4), and you arrive on the high ledge overlooking the glade, with m.player correctly on P14.

issues.issue: The vertical scale differs between these neighbouring maps. 1000000 and 1000001 use 0.4 m per 60 px tier; AUTHORING suggests 0.8-1.2 m, or about 0.72 m per 60 px for big spans. 1000002 uses about 0.65. Effects: the Field's sunken Hollow is only 1.2 m deep, and its 'sheer, unjumpable' east cliff is 1.2 m against a 1.5 m player, so it reads as a kerb (with a silly 1.2 m Rope_Cliff_G7). The Small Forest's identical 1140 px climb tops out at 7.6 m, while Dangerous Forest's 1140 px span reaches 12.8 m. The ground band of the Field reads as nearly flat in both renders.
issues.fix: Pick one shared rule (for example 0.6 m per tier, capped at 14 m) and apply it. Field: Z_ROAD 1.2 -> 2.0, G2/G4/G8 -> 1.4, G5/G9 -> 0.7, using stairs or ramps where a step exceeds 0.45 m, and shift the upper bands up about 0.8 (summit about 11.6). The Hollow and its 2 m cliff then read and justify the rope and ramp. SF: shelf_z step 0.4 -> 0.55, so the tower is about 10 m and matches DF's height.

issues.issue: The four back-edge gates are visually identical barrel arches in two pairs: in00/in04 at x 4/14 and in05/in01 at x 56/66 (Overview top-left and top-right). Their distinguishing danger signs (X1000000_Sign_Danger_Excl/Skull/Board, about 1.15-1.8 m) stand 2-6 m off to the side, at (5.6,43.4), (10.6,45.4), (53.4,45.4) and (63.4,45.0), and are about 10 px specks at overview scale. You cannot tell the Small Forest door from Hunting Ground I, or the Dangerous Forest door from Hunting Ground II, although the classic 'little doors with danger signs' are a core recognizer.
issues.fix: Scale the sign assets 1.8-2x and place them right beside each arch opening, facing -y. Differentiate the gates by destination. in01 (Dangerous Forest): darker barrel staves, hanging ivy over the arch and the DANGER board on the keystone. in04/in05: a skull plaque on the arch. in00: the '!' triangle plus autumn bushes. Optionally add a small coloured banner or plaque per gate so each pair is distinguishable from the Overview.

issues.issue: Worn paths exist only on the front road and on the last 3-5 m before each upper door (Path_in00/in04/in05/in01). The long upper routes have no visual path: VFork_West_to_in00 through P22, P24, P21 and P17; VFork_East_to_in01 through P26a/b; ToSummit and To_in05. Six large plank staircases and loose dirt rectangles compete for attention instead. The dirt-topped ramps R_P05_P07, R_P07_P10 and R_P10_P11a between the rope-yard stumps (about 25-35, 20-26) render as disconnected flat strips, plus a sliver at the plateau lip (Gameplay top-left, about 100-370, 300-550). From the Overview it is not obvious how to reach any upper door.
issues.fix: Add 1.8-2.2 m m.path ribbons along VFork_West_to_in00, VFork_East_to_in01, ToSummit and To_in05, merging into the existing Path_inXX stubs. Make the rope-yard ramps grass-topped (pass top_mat=None, as 1000002 does) or run one continuous path over them. Consider replacing one or two of the six plank stairs with earthen ramps to reduce brown clutter.

issues.issue: P36 (36-50.6 x 43.4-49.8) is a thin strip on the back edge, only 2 m above the summit skirt. Its five green and lime grove birches blend into the dark world forest behind it. It is reached by the only grey cobble element on the map (St_Skirt_Summit uses M_StoneWall; AUTHORING reserves stone for Amherst). In the Overview it reads as a small ledge behind a concrete-looking ramp (about 600-800, 210-260), not as the 'wooded summit holding the Orange Mushrooms'.
issues.fix: Pull the summit forward and enlarge it, for example rounded_rect(37.5,40.8,50.6,48.6) with top of about 11.6. Switch St_Skirt_Summit to M_Plank or a grassy ramp. Make the grove a ring of autumn birches (Tree_Birch_Yellow/Orange) on the summit so it contrasts with the green world forest. Place the 2 Orange Mushroom proxies near its front lip so they are visible.

issues.issue: Nothing about the palette or density says 'Dangerous Forest'. It uses the same lime M_Grass, open sunny lawns, birches and flower scatter as the Field and Small Forest; the Overview could be any Rainbow Street field. 5 of the 13 dark pines meant to add gloom were deleted by route clearing. The classic minimap shows a dense forest with yellow and orange canopies on the shelf and floor and brown autumn trees at the floor's west end.
issues.fix: After the route fixes restore the pines, densify the canopy along the shelf foot and shelf back (y 15-26) and the ridge back rim with Tree_Tall_A, pines and rust birches. Keep the front floor band low (small bushes, mushrooms, mossy rocks). Add Vine_Hanging_A on every soil face, not only the vine curtain. Reduce flower scatter in favour of grass tufts and mushrooms. See also the shared dark-grass style issue.

issues.issue: Pillar_P06, Pillar_P07 and the four CrenelStep_* terraces use style='grass_stone'. They render as cobbled grey-blue masonry silos (Overview about 520-800, 290-400) and read as castle towers. The brief stresses that nothing man-made appears in this map, and AUTHORING reserves stone styles for Amherst.
issues.fix: Use grass_dirt with a few Rock_Cliff_Stone embedded, or build the pillars as giant tree stumps (bark side material, a ring-textured top). This matches the brief's 'rock or stump pillars' and keeps the battlement rhythm.

issues.issue: VALIDATION.md: 1000000 is over the 400k triangle budget. Per-asset counts from MapleIsland.blend show the overrun is dominated by flower dressing, not landmarks. About 76 Flower_Patch_A/B at about 1.27k tris each (about 96k) plus 5 Flower_Bed_Large at about 4.5k each (about 23k) make about 120k tris of flowers. There are also 764 auto-placed Rock_Cliff_Stone objects. 1000001 (about 40k in flower patches) and 1000002 follow the same pattern.
issues.fix: Shared: rebuild Flower_Patch_A/B at 300 tris or fewer (fewer, lower-segment flower heads, flat shading) and Flower_Bed_Large at about 1.2k or fewer; consider merging auto cliff stones per terrace into one mesh. Map: cut the three scatter counts in 1000000 (46/18/46) by about 30% and drop one or two Flower_Bed_Large.

issues.issue: Rope_Hill_P08 is at (25.4,10.9) with z0 0.8, but the ground under its foot is the glade floor at z 0.0 (probed at (25.4,10.4); P02b, the step at 0.8, ends at y 8.6). The rope foot hangs 0.8 m in the air. build_report records climbable_issues foot_ok:false, and this alone makes 1000001 fail traversal in VALIDATION.md.
issues.fix: Set z0=0.0 (a 3.2 m rope down to the floor), or extend P02b to y of about 11 so the rope foot lands on the 0.8 m step.

issues.issue: The classic minimap shows a dense stand of white-trunk autumn trees along the floor and the top ledge. Here about 15 birches sit mostly on the ledges. The glade floor (x 0-20, y 0-10) is an open lawn framed by generic dark-green world-forest trees. Three brown plank staircases (St_Floor_P01, St_Hill_P08, St_P14_P24) are the most eye-catching objects in both renders, which makes the forest feel like a park.
issues.fix: Ring the floor's west edge and back with 6-8 more autumn birches, using smaller ones near the front edge to keep the front band low, and add 2-3 more along the P24 ridge back edge. Replace St_Floor_P01 and St_Hill_P08 with grassy ramps or stump steps (as 1000002 does), keeping planks only for the P14-P24 climb.

issues.issue: The giant pale stalk-mushrooms (X1000000_StalkMushroom_Cluster) have stem radii of 0.13-0.24 m and sit at (76.4,27.2) and (79.0,23.6), near the east edge behind the St_P12_P26c stairs and a tree. In the Overview (about 1355-1440, 360-420) they read as a few thin white sticks, not the oversized balcony landmark.
issues.fix: Double the stem radii and cap domes, place them at scale of about 1.4, and move them to the P12 front lip (about x 70-74, y 18.5-20.5) so they stand out above the East Gate.

issues.issue: The 'Amherst ->' signboard is the generic Sign_Board/Sign_Arrow pair at (75.4,14.6) and (77.4,15.0). It is small, blank-looking and behind the sunflowers. The classic map has a prominent orange arrow signboard beside east00.
issues.fix: Add a local, larger orange arrow-shaped plank sign pointing east at the road edge (about 75,9.5), facing -y, so it reads from both cameras.

issues.issue: The Field in01 -> Dangerous Forest trail is 14 m with a 2.8 m rise (21.7 degrees), the steepest of the region's 8 trails (the others are 15.4 degrees or less). The 64 m in05 -> Hunting Ground II trail leaves 10 m from the in01 gate and runs along DF's west edge right beside the DF entry bluff (DF Overview, left strip about 230-340), so arriving at DF shows two parallel dirt roads. Trail ends otherwise meet the edge portals cleanly (west00/east00 on the road, in02/in03 leaving the front edge, in04/in05/in01 through their gates). The exception is in00 (see the high issue).
issues.fix: If DF is lowered (see the descent issue), the in01 trail flattens by itself. Otherwise lengthen the (1000002,'out01') gap to about 18 m. Plant a hedge or tree line (world keep-out scenery) between the in05 trail embankment and DF's west edge so the two routes read as separate.

issues.issue: TERRAIN_STYLES has no darker grass variant: every grass style uses M_Grass. Forest sub-maps (Dangerous Forest, the Hunting Grounds) therefore cannot be tonally separated from the open fields, which hurts distinctiveness across the island.
issues.fix: Add a 'grass_dark_dirt' entry (a mossier, slightly desaturated M_Grass_Dark cap with M_Dirt_Cliff sides) and use it for 1000002's floor and shelf caps, possibly also the Hunting Grounds.

issues.issue: The floating-prop check flags 13 DangerousForest Rock_Cliff_Stone (face-embedded by design) and 36 X1000002_Vine_Leaves segments (stacked along vines by design) as floating. This noise buries real floaters, such as the 1000001 rope foot.
issues.fix: Exempt assets tagged 'vine' or 'wall_mounted', and Rock_Cliff_Stone within about 0.4 m of a terrace side face, from the floating check.

issues.issue: The Trail_W, Trail_M and Trail_E decals end in square notches where they meet the dirt-topped ramps Bluff_To_G2 (x 8.6-12) and G2_To_G3 (x 20-24.4). This shows as sawtooth breaks in the floor trail (Overview about 600-940, 720-770). A thin dark seam line also crosses the entry bluff where the world trail slab meets the bluff cap at z 2.0.
issues.fix: Overlap each decal about 0.5 m onto the ramp tops, or draw one continuous m.path along the Descent route. Trim the world-trail inner slab to the bluff edge, or sink it 2-3 cm below the bluff cap.
